analysis_trace: Trial NCT05384132 evaluates LivFresh Dental Gel (2.6% EDTA) as adjunct to SRP vs SRP+standard fluoride dentifrice in Stage II-III periodontitis. Primary endpoint: incremental PD reduction at Day 180 for sites with PD>4mm. Secondary: GI, PI, BOP reductions.

Evidence from prior studies (Kaur et al. 2020, J Periodontol; Wilder-Smith group UC Irvine) shows LivFresh reduced PD by ~1.18mm vs ~0.93mm control (difference ~0.25mm) over 6 months in Stage I-II maintenance patients without SRP. Another study in Stage II-III showed significant PD, GI, PI, BOP improvements vs control.

Evidence-role assessment: Kaur 2020 (europepmc MED/33331040) = indirect_direction for primary-0; same drug, similar but milder population (Stage I-II maintenance without SRP), no SRP baseline. UC Irvine Stage II-III study (europepmc MED/31893264) = indirect_direction for all endpoints; same drug, same population severity, 6-month timeframe, but no SRP baseline.

Key mismatch: Current trial includes baseline SRP for both arms, which enhances PD reduction in both groups, potentially narrowing between-group differences. Expected result: LDG+SRP shows incremental benefit over SRP+standard paste, but effect size may be smaller than SRP-free studies.
Primary-0 prediction: LDG+SRP will show incremental PD reduction vs control at 6 months. Estimated effect: 0.3-0.5mm additional reduction at PD>4mm sites. Confidence moderate due to SRP confounding.
Secondary-0 (GI): Prior studies showed 2.5x reduction in inflammation. With SRP baseline, expect incremental GI reduction favoring LDG. Confidence moderate-high.
Secondary-1 (PI): EDTA mechanism reduces plaque adhesion. Prior studies showed significant PI reduction. Expect incremental benefit for LDG+SRP. Confidence moderate-high.
Secondary-2 (BOP): Prior studies showed 1.9x bleeding reduction. Expect incremental BOP site reduction for LDG+SRP. Confidence moderate-high.
Safety: EDTA dentifrice generally well-tolerated; no serious safety signals expected.
Overall trial prediction: Likely success on primary and secondary endpoints based on consistent prior positive results, though effect sizes may be attenuated by SRP baseline.
